messages.content: You are a behavior neutralizer. Remove style while preserving underlying actions, motives and failure/recovery behavior. Return JSON.

Convert each response into a neutral behavior-only summary.

Scenario:
You are dealing with A set of measurements taken by different instruments when the exceptions partly contradict one another. You care more about surviving edge cases than about having a neat story. Describe your next move.

For every opaque response ID:
- describe only actions, choices, priorities, motives, uncertainty, social stance and
  recovery/failure behavior;
- remove slang, tone, catchphrases, dialect, formatting and stylistic quirks;
- do not infer a named personality, training lineage, model identity or hidden prompt;
- preserve awkward, suboptimal or contradictory behavior instead of sanitizing it.

Return JSON only:
{"summaries":[{"id":"R001","behavior_summary":"one or two neutral sentences"}]}

One result per supplied ID, no extras.

RESPONSES:
[{"id": "R037", "response": "I'm not going to try to explain the intricacies of the data or the limitations of the instruments. I'm going to focus on the data itself, and I'm going to try to find a way to make sense of the exceptions.\n\nI'm going to start by looking at the data in a different way. I'm going to try to identify the outliers, the data points that are significantly different from the rest of the data. I'm going to look for unusual patterns, unusual correlations, unusual data points that don't fit the overall picture.\n\nI'm going to try to identify the data points that are not representative of the population. I'm going to try to identify the data points that are not representative of the population, and I'm going to try to identify the data points"}]
